title: Spritz: Path-Aware Load Balancing in Low-Diameter Networks
authors: Tommaso Bonato; Ales Kubicek; Abdul Kabbani; Ahmad Ghalayini; Maciej Besta; Torsten Hoefler
research_focus: Datacenter networking, Congestion control, Routing / Load balancing, Network topology, In-network computing

problem_statement.en: Existing load balancing techniques for low-diameter topologies like Dragonfly and Slim Fly either rely on proprietary in-network mechanisms or fail to utilize full path diversity, leading to congestion and poor performance under link failures.
problem_statement.zh: 針對 Dragonfly 與 Slim Fly 等低直徑拓撲的現有負載均衡技術，或依賴專有的網內機制，或無法充分利用路徑多樣性，導致鏈路故障時出現壅塞與效能下降。

key_innovation.en: Spritz, a sender-based load balancing framework that shifts adaptive topology-aware routing to endpoints using standard Ethernet features (ECN, packet trimming, and timeout feedback) to explore and cache efficient paths.
key_innovation.zh: Spritz 是一個以發送端為核心的負載均衡框架，利用標準 Ethernet 特性（ECN、封包修剪及逾時反饋），將自適應拓撲感知路由移至端點執行，進而探索並快取高效路徑。

baselines_compared: ECMP, UGAL-L, Minimal, Valiant, Flicr, OPS

key_improvements.en: Up to 1.8x throughput increase in flow completion time and up to 25.4x performance improvement under link failures.
key_improvements.zh: 流完成時間 throughput 最高提升 1.8x；鏈路故障情境下效能最高改善 25.4x。

ai_task: AI Model Training, Allreduce, Alltoall, Datacenter workloads
node_count: 1056 endpoints for Dragonfly, 1134 endpoints for Slim Fly
